净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Sales yield (1/ps_ttm) is a stable value metric. Multiplying by inattention (1 - rank of free_turn) amplifies the value effect when attention is low. The parent had strong RankIC/ICIR but weaker IC; winsorizing the product at rolling 5th/95th percentiles reduces extreme values that harm linear correlation while preserving rank ordering and the economic mechanism.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

1/ps_ttm * (1 - ts_rank(free_turn, 20)), then rolling 60-day winsorize at 5% and 95% quantiles to reduce outlier drag on IC.
依赖列: ps_ttm, free_turn

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

1/ps_ttm * (1 - ts_rank(free_turn, 20)), then rolling 60-day winsorize at 5% and 95% quantiles to reduce outlier drag on IC.
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. winsorize —— 极值裁剪
    winsorize(ts_rank(divide(1, ps_ttm), 20))
  2. 2. ts_rank —— 过去 N 天内排序分位(0~1)
    ts_rank(divide(1, ps_ttm), 20)
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, ps_ttm)
使用字段：
列含义说明
ps_ttmps_ttm（中间变量/衍生量）

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_rank滚动排名（当前值在 n 期窗口内的百分位排名）
winsorize对截面数据进行缩尾处理（极值截断）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 sales_yield：1.0 / ps_ttm
  2. 计算 inattention：1.0 - free_turn.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct=True)
  3. 计算 sales_yield：sales_yield.ffill()
  4. 计算 inattention：inattention.ffill()
  5. 计算 raw：sales_yield * inattention
  6. 计算 lower：raw.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=20).quantile(0.05)
  7. 计算 upper：raw.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=20).quantile(0.95)
  8. 计算 winsorized：raw.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsor(df): df_copy = df.copy() sales_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["ps_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) inattention = 1.0 - df_copy["free_turn"].rolling(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) sales_yield = sales_yield.ffill() inattention = inattention.ffill() raw = sales_yield * inattention lower = raw.rolling(60, min_periods=20).quantile(0.05) upper = raw.rolling(60, min_periods=20).quantile(0.95) winsorized = raw.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper) df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsor"] = winsorized "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsor"]
